# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is dominated by **internal operations chatter** — loading/unloading coordination, driver directions, e-way bill/GST system outages, gift-distribution logistics for Diwali, payment/bank transfer follow-ups, and stock-counting between warehouse staff. These were excluded per instructions.

The **genuine sales calls** that remain are a moderate but fragmented set — mostly short, transactional exchanges rather than full consultative sales pitches. They fall into a few repeatable patterns: (1) inbound rate enquiries for JSW-brand roofing sheets, PUF panels, polycarbonate and decking sheets; (2) existing dealers/fabricators asking for screws, welding rods, and accessories; (3) price-matching objections where customers quote a competitor's or another salesperson's rate; and (4) outbound cold-calls by Crayon reps (sometimes using sister/partner brand names like "Royal Roofing," "Triangle Roofing") pushing roofing sheets and Tata screws to prospects found via lead lists. Because most calls are quick quote-and-confirm exchanges rather than full objection-handling dialogues, this KB stays close to what is actually said, and is intentionally concise rather than padded with invented tactics.

## Products & brand ladder

Crayon Roofing & Structures positions itself as a **supplier/distributor of JSW metal roofing sheets and allied accessories**, explicitly **not a fabricator**:
> "Sir JSW metal roofing sheet நம்ம பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம். Supply பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம். Fixing எதுவும் பண்றது கிடையாது." [We only supply JSW sheets, we don't do fixing/fabrication.]

Product ladder mentioned across calls (price/quality tiers, low→high):
- **Pragathi / Pragathi Plus** — entry-level JSW metal sheet. Only **sky blue** and **off white/half white** colors stocked regularly: "Pragathi-ல sky blue off white மட்டும் தான் இருக்கும்." No grey, no brick red, no green available in Pragathi.
- **Indradhanush (JSW)** — 0.45mm, AZ 70 coating, sky blue/half white only, cheaper than Color On Plus.
- **JSW Color On Plus** — full color range: "color on plus-னா நம்ம எல்லா color-உம் இருக்கும் sky blue off white grey blue red எல்லாமே இருக்கும்." Thickness options 0.40/0.45/0.47/0.50/0.60mm, coating AZ 150 or AZ 70.
- **Silver On / Bare Galvalume** — plain/silver finish sheets sold by kg, e.g. 0.47mm AZ150 at ₹100–101+GST/kg.
- **PUF (Puff) roof panels** — 50mm insulated panels, sold per square meter, top/bottom skin thickness specified separately.
- **Polycarbonate sheets** — stocked in 2mm; customers often ask to choose between "price-cheap" vs "thicker" variant.
- **Decking sheets** — 0.8mm / 1mm / 1.2mm; 0.8mm is production-constrained ("0.8 தான் இப்ப order ஓடிண்டு இருக்கான்").
